description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans Reminders Table implementation using SQL Server as the backend. It defines a test class with setup, utility methods, and specific test methods for initializing and testing reminder functionalities in SQL Server.

classes.name: SqlServerRemindersTableTests
classes.description: Unit tests class for testing the Orleans reminders table implementation with SQL Server. It inherits from ReminderTableTestsBase and includes specific tests and setup for SQL Server environment.

methods.name: CreateFilters
methods.description: Creates and configures LoggerFilterOptions for logging filter levels specific to this test class.

methods.name: CreateRemindersTable
methods.description: Overrides base method to create and return an instance of AdoNetReminderTable configured for SQL Server.

methods.name: GetAdoInvariant
methods.description: Returns the invariant name for SQL Server ADO.NET provider.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Asynchronously sets up a test instance of the relational storage and retrieves its connection string.

methods.name: RemindersTable_SqlServer_Init
methods.description: Test for initialization of the reminders table in SQL Server.

methods.name: RemindersTable_SqlServer_RemindersRange
methods.description: Test that checks reminders within a range in SQL Server, runs 30 iterations.

methods.name: RemindersTable_SqlServer_RemindersParallelUpsert
methods.description: Test for concurrent upserting of reminders in SQL Server.

methods.name: RemindersTable_SqlServer_ReminderSimple
methods.description: Test for simple reminder functionality in SQL Server.
